suggestions.reasoning: While routine manufacturing and assembly face high automation risks globally as noted by McKinsey & Company (2023) and Goldman Sachs (2023), specialized manual craftsmanship in luxury goods thrives on human touch, precision, and trust. Furthermore, TopCV (2024) indicates that digital integration is crucial for surviving contracting traditional markets by capturing higher-value clientele online.
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: Your 15 years of precision craftsmanship and absolute patience perfectly match the demands of high-end mechanical watch restoration. Instead of competing with mass manufacturing, moving into digital curation allows you to leverage your existing reputation with clients while opening new online avenues for your small business interest.
